notes: Read-only capture on a healthy running commander service. CPU/RSS via tools/sample_resource.sh (--match commander/main.py, 60 samples, label running_baseline; PID 603 cmdline verified: python3 /home/pi/services/commander/main.py). SLO via tools/probe_http.sh on safe GET /raspi/vcgencmd and GET /raspi/eeprom_update with i_know_what_i_am_doing=true (--repeats 20). No destructive POST endpoints called (shutdown, set_time, settings/reset, eeprom_update POST, camera_legacy POST, command/host). Pi-specific raspi/* endpoints may error on non-Pi boards. Raw evidence: /tmp/commander_sample.json, /tmp/commander_slo.json.

v1.0.note: Confirmed routes on live Pi via /commander/v1.0/openapi.json; only safe GETs probed for SLO.

running_baseline.note: GET contracts on a healthy running commander (idle, no mutating actions). i_know_what_i_am_doing=true required for raspi inspection routes.

slo_running_baseline.note: vcgencmd runs three sudo vcgencmd subprocesses per request; eeprom_update runs sudo rpi-eeprom-update (read-only check).

settings_mutations.note: mutating endpoints (settings reset) are destructive and were not exercised; not captured

platform_matrix.note: raspi/vcgencmd and raspi/eeprom_update are Pi-specific (vcgencmd, rpi-eeprom-update); may error on non-Pi boards. Runtime captured on Navigator (Raspberry Pi 4) only.

state_machine: none — commander has no service-level lifecycle state machine (see service_definition states: Unknown)
